title: Food Safety Request Form
subtitle: Food Safety Control: defines need, constraints, and assignment.
description: Food Safety Request Form covers food lot, process step, sanitation control, monitoring point, and corrective action. The food-safety record owner records Food Safety Control need, timing, access, and assignment. Food Safety Request Form keeps Food Safety Control exceptions visible until the food-safety record owner handoff.
use_case: Use Food Safety Request Form at receiving, storage, preparation, processing, packing, and service area. Document food lot, process step, sanitation control, monitoring point, and corrective action identity before Food Safety Control begins. Compare food lot, process step, sanitation control, monitoring point, and corrective action findings with stated Food Safety Control criteria; route unresolved Food Safety Control issues to qualified food-safety reviewer. For Food Safety Request Form, confirm requirements for Food Safety Control. Ask qualified food-safety reviewer to review Food Safety Control conditions beyond the food-safety record owner's role.

sections.title: Requester, location, and subject details
sections.guidance: For Food Safety Control, identify responsible parties, receiving, storage, preparation, processing, packing, and service area, and the linked food lot, process step, sanitation control, monitoring point, and corrective action source.

sections.guidance: Resolve open Food Safety Control request questions; have food-safety record owner record the assignment, response owner, and requester follow-up while keeping the record strictly at the intake and routing stage.

blocks.guidance: Do not assign or authorize the Food Safety Control request when product control, traceability, contamination, corrective action, or qualified disposition remains unresolved. Retain information supplied with the request and route unresolved constraints to food-safety record owner.
